symptom: ako/mxcli#2005 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1772): `create persistent entity M.Child extends M.Base` with Base non-persistent reported "Created entity" and wrote a non-persistent Child (and the reverse: non-persistent extends a persistent entity wrote a persistent one); check passed both.
cause: Persistable lives only on DomainModels$NoGeneralization; a specialization's DomainModels$Generalization holds the parent's name and nothing else, so the stated keyword had nowhere to go and the writer's GeneralizationRef branch dropped it. The visitor also defaulted Kind to persistent, so a stated keyword could not be told from none.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_entities_persistability.go (checkSpecializationPersistability / persistabilityRoot: script decls, then project index, then meta.SystemEntityPersistable), called from execCreateEntity (mdl/executor/cmd_entities.go) and validateWithContext (mdl/executor/validate.go); ast.CreateEntityStmt.KindStated set in mdl/visitor/visitor_entity.go
insight: Same class as the Auto* system members on a specialization (2026-10-02 finding): a value with no storage slot on a specialization is decided by the chain's ROOT, not the direct parent. Check must read the script's own declarations — the reported shape creates the parent in the same script, which the system-member check leaves to exec. Keep the keyword legal when it matches: describe prints the inherited keyword, so refusing every stated keyword would break the round trip (pinned by a test).
